Truly grateful to the Government of Telangana @youngfilmmakerschallenge for inviting me to the Bathukamma Young Film Makers Challenge Awards 2026. ❤️🎬

It was an honour to be part of such a memorable event, meet inspiring personalities, interact with respected IAS officers, and learn valuable lessons from the Hon’ble Deputy Chief Minister of Telangana and Dil Raju garu.

An evening filled with inspiration, learning, meaningful conversations, and unforgettable memories. Experiences like these motivate me to dream bigger, keep learning, and work harder towards my goals.

Thank you for this wonderful opportunity. This is a memory I’ll always cherish! 🙏✨

#Telangana #BathukammaYoungFilmMakersChallenge2026 #YoungFilmmakers #TelanganaGovernment #Gratitude HarishVibes❤️

Honoured to be part of an important discussion on Digital Policy with the Government of Telangana. 🤝

Had a great meeting with renowned Telugu film producer Sri Dil Raju Garu , IAS  sir, and creative Director sir an opportunity to share ideas on how digital policies can create meaningful opportunities for creators, empower the youth, and bring positive change to society.

I truly believe that when the Government and the Creator Community come together, we can build a better digital future for everyone. 🇮🇳

Looking forward to contributing to initiatives that benefit both creators and the people.

[DigitalPolicy #Telangana DigitalIndia TeluguCreators]

If you’re going through a 👇tough phase right now…
Don’t worry. Your story is not over.
You’re not failing — you’re becoming.
Here’s proof:
At age 19: My life was full of pain,  struggle, and confusion.
I didn’t know my purpose. I just kept surviving.
At age 20: I made a comeback.
I worked harder than ever and gifted my father his dream bike — a promise fulfilled.
At  age 21: My mom wanted to see me in a job.
So I made her wish come true — and her smile gave me strength.
At age 22: I discovered my passion and purpose to Help  people by providing employment and being capable to helping them to achieve their Goals. And  build stronger mindsets, better careers, and grow with Ai.
At age 23 (Now): Turning 23 Today & I’m ready to put my blood and sweat into building the life I dream of. 
Thank you 🙏 Everyone for Following me on This Journey 🔥
❤️‍🔥 And here’s why I’m sharing this…
If you are struggling right now, please know this:
You are not alone.
Your story is not done.
Your comeback is loading.
And the world needs your success.
If a confused, lost 19-year-old kid like me can change his life…
You can rewrite yours too.
Stay hungry.
Stay unstoppable.
Your time is coming. ❤️‍🔥🔥
